verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party bulk-operation capability, such as bulk-editing, bulk-toggling, or bulk-deleting many flags, segments, or identities in one action. Segment overrides are a targeting feature, not bulk item management. The Admin API, CLI, and MCP server are building blocks a user could script loops with, and Release Pipelines promote flags through stages; neither is a documented bulk operation, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
